Detroit Lions Linebacker Jack Campbell Hospitalized with Neck Injury

Detroit Lions linebacker Jack Campbell was hospitalized with a neck injury during a game against the Vikings. He was placed on a backboard and carted off the field after a tackle. Campbell is staying overnight at the hospital. As of the reports, the Lions and head coach Dan Campbell did not have new information regarding the injury.
